entities.name: streetlights
entities.description: Streetlights are lighting fixtures installed along streets and roads to provide illumination for safety and visibility. They include various types such as wood pole, concrete pole, and private development streetlights on city right-of-way. The city promotes the use of its branded streetlights, including Denman Fink lights, and maintains street lighting as part of urban design and city branding efforts.

entities.name: urban design
entities.description: Urban design involves the aesthetic and functional planning of city spaces, including street furniture, lighting, and public monuments. It emphasizes the importance of city branding, historical preservation, and creating a welcoming environment for residents and visitors. The city aims to enhance its urban landscape through thoughtful design and maintenance of public elements like streetlights and monuments.

entities.name: branding
entities.description: Branding refers to the city's efforts to promote its unique identity through visual elements, monuments, and public spaces. It includes the use of distinctive street lighting, street jewelry, and monuments that reflect the city's history and character. The city seeks to strengthen its brand by maintaining and enhancing these elements to create a cohesive and attractive environment.
